blocks.text: Responsible digital behavior (online zimmedari wala rawayya) ka matlab hai technology aur internet ko izzat aur hifazat ke saath istemal karna. Is mein shamil hai:

items: Using Strong Passwords (mazboot password): Aise passwords banayein jinhein doosre aasani se andaza (guess) na kar sakein. Misal: “password123” jaisa password rakhne ke bajaye letters (huroof), numbers aur symbols (jaise @, #, !) mila kar password banayein.

Avoiding Phishing Scams (phishing ke dhokon se bachna): Suspicious (shak wale) links par click na karein aur anjaan logon ki woh emails na kholein jo personal maloomat maangti hain. Misal: Agar koi email bank ki hone ka daawa kare aur aap ke account ki details maange, to jawab dene se pehle verify karein (check karein) ke woh asli hai ya nahi.

blocks.text: Yeh saada program password mein letters, numbers aur symbols ginta hai aur lambai (length) dekh kar batata hai ke password kamzor hai ya mazboot. password ki value badal kar Run karein (maslan Lahore@2026), magar apna asli password yahan kabhi na likhein.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"password = "password123"": jaanchne wala password (yahan apna asli password kabhi na likhein).
"letters = digits = symbols = 0": teeno ginti (count) wale variables zero se shuru.
"for ch in password:": har character baari baari. "ch.isalpha()" harf (letter) ho to True, "ch.isdigit()" number ho to True; baqi sab symbol gina jata hai.
"score = sum([...])": char shartein (conditions): lambai 8 ya zyada, koi letter, koi number, koi symbol. Har True 1 ginta hai aur False 0, is liye sum() poori hone wali shartein ginta hai.
"if password.lower() in [...]": agar password bohat aam list mein ho to score seedha 0, kyun ke yeh foran guess ho jata hai.
Aakhri if / elif / else: score 4 par "Mazboot", 3 par "Theek hai...", warna "Kamzor".
Output: "Letters: 8 | Numbers: 3 | Symbols: 0 | Lambai: 11" aur "Kamzor (weak) password". Score pehle 3 banta hai (symbol nahi), magar "password123" aam list mein hai is liye 0.
Khud try karein: password = "Lahore@2026" kar ke Run karein: Letters 6, Numbers 4, Symbols 1 aur "Mazboot (strong) password" aayega.

blocks.prompt: MCQ 10: In mein se kaunsa kaam responsible digital behavior (zimmedari wala rawayya) NAHI?
blocks.explanation: (b) Social media par jhooti maloomat phailana.

items: Responsible behavior: mazboot password (letters, numbers, symbols), phishing se bachao (bank ki email verify karna).
